name: marketgame-click
description: Market Game 5.0 — web version for the U.S. market

scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/golden.mjs && node tests/scale_check.mjs && node tests/v5_check.mjs && node tests/schema_check.mjs
scripts.test:api: npm run build && node tests/api/game_flow.mjs && node tests/api/extras.mjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node tests/i18n_check.mjs && node tests/ui/screens.mjs
scripts.vendor: printf "export { AuthClient } from '@supabase/auth-js';\n" > build/auth-entry.mjs && esbuild build/auth-entry.mjs --bundle --format=esm --minify --platform=browser --target=es2020 --legal-comments=eof --outfile=web/assets/js/vendor/supabase-auth.js
